Web design questions Adelaide businesses ask A quick rundown of the things people check before starting a website project. How much does it cost to get a website designed in Adelaide? Prices vary with the size and complexity of the site. A simple brochure-style website for a small business usually starts in the low thousands, while custom, ecommerce or booking-enabled sites cost more. Hosting and domain renewal are ongoing costs on top. We ask the right questions upfront so you get a clear, itemised quote rather than a vague estimate. How long does it take to build a new website in Adelaide? Most small business websites take around 3 to 8 weeks from brief to launch, depending on the scope and how quickly content is supplied. Simple one-page sites can be faster, while larger custom builds take longer. Agreeing timelines and milestones early keeps the project on track. What is included in a web design package? A typical package covers planning, design, build, basic on-page SEO setup, mobile optimisation and going live on your domain. Some builds also include stock imagery, content structure and a short training session. Ongoing maintenance and marketing are usually separate. We confirm exactly what is and isn't included before work starts. Who owns my website once it is built?
